verdict.rationale: Moss, a semantic search runtime rather than an agent, documents an official MCP server integration. Through it an AI assistant can create indexes, add documents, and run semantic queries without leaving the conversation, and a probe confirms the official MCP server documentation page exists. Missing for 10: setup/configuration details (transport, install command, supported clients), a full tool list, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Your AI assistant can create indexes, add documents, and run sub-10ms semantic queries without leaving the conversation.
